BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, gᵉrushâh means expulsion, violence, dispossession, act of expulsion. It occurs just once, in Ezekiel.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: gᵉrushâh means expulsion, violence, dispossession, act of expulsion, and I do not stretch it further.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
